messages:
Maya: Thanks again for coming to the all-hands — quick follow-up thread for links, clarifications, and action items. I captured a few Qs that came up live and the answers we promised.

Rio: recording and slides here -> https://internal.redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23 (video + deck)

Ana: Can you confirm the Dedicated SLA start date? The slide said H2 but we need month for contract language.

Maya: Good call — Dedicated SLA is effective starting 2026-08-01 for new reserved contracts. Existing Dedicated customers get the SLA applied at next renewal unless they opt-in earlier.

CJ: Is Private (VPC) GA the same timeline? We heard "late Q3" on the call.

Maya: Private GA moves slightly later — target 2026-09-15. We're tracking a couple security certification blockers (KMS integration and audit logs retention).

Sam: Billing question from finance: will the new tiered burst pricing be line-itemed or included in the committed spend?

Rio: Burst is billed separately as a usage line item. Committed spend still covers baseline reserved GPUs; burst usage shows as "Burst Capacity" in invoices. Finance will get the billing schema doc shortly.

Ana: Who owns the follow-up to publish the billing schema? Need a single owner for the legal pack.

CJ: assigning @Sam to own billing schema doc and coordinate with Finance & Legal. Sam, can you confirm by EOD? :slightly_smiling_face:

Sam: yep — I'll loop in Leah (Finance) and Priya (Legal) and post the draft here today.

Maya: Quick tech clarification asked during the Q&A about rollout fallback behavior when a model variant is unavailable. Short answer: automatic fallback to compatible quantized variant in the same region, then cross-region failover if policy allows.

Rio: snippet from rollout policy we referenced during QA:

```
policy: 
  - prefer: replica-optimized
  - fallback: quantized-compatible
  - cross_region_failover: conditional
  - max_latency_ms: 200
```

Maya: Ops note: for teams wanting immediate GA access to Private, we can do early access + NDA. Ping me with team name and expected capacity and we'll evaluate.

CJ: action item list (from live Q&A):
- Sam: publish billing schema + legal pack (owner)
- Rio: upload annotated slides + recording (done)
- Maya: draft early-access process for Private (owner)
- Ana: confirm Dedicated SLA language for contracts (owner)

Ana: I have a follow-up doc question — where should we store the contract language snippet? Contracts repo or legal drive?

Sam: put the canonical snippet in contracts repo (private/legal-access) and a copy in the all-hands notes for quick reference.

DeployBot: Recording processing complete for 1782000055. Transcript available at https://internal.redwood.ai/transcripts/1782000055.txt

Maya: Thanks @everyone. I'll update the public roadmap doc with the explicit dates and link back here when done. If anyone has additional follow-ups, drop them in this thread or DM me. :rocket:
